story_text:
As a user, I want to receive real-time notifications in my browser so that I don't have to refresh the page.

AC1: WebSocket connection established on page load
AC2: Automatic reconnection with exponential backoff
AC3: Message types: info, warning, error, success
AC4: Notification sounds (configurable)
AC5: Notification history (last 50)
AC6: Works on mobile browsers (fallback to SSE)
architecture_text: WebSocket server in Node.js with Socket.io. Redis pub/sub for multi-server broadcast. Client stores last 50 in localStorage. SSE fallback for old browsers.
